question: Fill in the blank (2) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**seize**" means to take hold of something quickly and firmly. (पकड़ना)
 
• In this context, "enabling them to seize opportunities" emphasizes how education allows individuals to take advantage of available opportunities effectively.
 
• The other options: "**endure**", "**exploit**", and "**afflict**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Education is a powerful tool for development and personal growth. It equips individuals with knowledge and skills, enabling them to seize__ opportunities and contribute to society. A well-rounded education not only fosters academic excellence but also encourages out-of-the-box thinking and creativity. Moreover, education instils virtuous values and ethical principles in individuals, promoting social harmony and responsible citizenship. To ensure the benefits of education are accessible to all, it is essential to eliminate barriers, such as isolation and discrimination, that hinder equal access to quality learning opportunities.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Endure (सहन करना)**: means to suffer patiently or remain in existence.
 
• **Exploit (शोषण करना)**: means to make full use of and derive benefit from, often in an unfair manner.
 
• **Afflict (पीड़ित करना)**: means to cause pain or suffering to someone or something.
